posts.title: Concerning a Variant in the de Fuentes Manuscript
posts.description: In his De Orbe Novo (1516), Peter Martyr of Angleria records a cosmogony of the Taíno people of Hispaniola, derived from the earlier report of the friar Ramón Pané. Pané notes that his informant, a baptized cacique named Íñigo, told the story reluctantly and in fragments, and that he himself had to assemble it into coherent form.
